parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The domain name to be accelerated. You can add only one domain name per request.

Wildcard domains are supported. A wildcard domain must start with a period (.), for example, `.example.com`.

parameters.name: FunctionType
parameters.description:
The computing service type. Valid values:

- **routine**: Routine.

- **image**: Image.

- **cloudFunction**: Cloud function.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. If you omit this parameter, the system uses the ID of the default resource group.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description:
The service scope. Valid values:

- **domestic**: Chinese mainland.

- **overseas**: Regions outside the Chinese mainland.

- **global**: Global.

Default value: **domestic**.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags to add to the domain. You can add up to 20 tags.
